items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Don Schlitten did the same thing for Muse Records.

ctx.x: Some of the other records you did for Prestige included one with Jerome Richardson, Ray Bryant, Wendell Marshall and Art Taylor.

Very fine players. They elected them I'll give them credit -- they elected everybody on there. Before I know anything, they say 'we got a session for you' -- Don Schlitten did the same thing for Muse Records. They selected the people...
How about the tunes? Did you get to pick the tunes?
